capabilities: convert \(...\) and \[...\] delimiters to $ and $$ in the active note
bulk-convert all notes in the vault
skip fenced code blocks and inline code spans during conversion
preserve multi-line \(...\) expressions to avoid destructive rewrites
run active-note conversion from a ribbon icon
extras: README warns to commit or back up the vault before bulk conversion since the plugin modifies files; installation is manual only (no community plugin store instructions).
problem: Vaults with formulas written in paren/bracket LaTeX delimiters don't render, because Obsidian expects $...$ and $$...$$.
summary: Delimiter converter that rewrites \(...\) and \[...\] LaTeX math delimiters into Obsidian-native $ and $$ syntax in notes.
